title: Maternal Instinct
plot_overview: Police stop a woman who says she has just given birth, but troubling inconsistencies quickly emerge: the baby and the blood are not hers. This true-crime documentary follows the investigation as conflicting accounts and hidden details come to light.
will_you_like_this: You may enjoy this if you like unsettling true-crime documentaries built around conflicting stories and urgent investigations; Not for you if you prefer lighter, fictional mysteries or clear-cut cases.
review_summary: Pros: gripping premise; true-crime intrigue; unsettling mystery | Cons: limited review consensus; potentially disturbing subject; details withheld
